scripts.dev:all: bun run --no-orphans --parallel dev:web dev:invitation dev:admin pb
scripts.dev:web: set -a; . ./.env.dev; set +a; bun run --cwd apps/web dev -- --mode dev
scripts.dev:invitation: set -a; . ./.env.dev; set +a; bun run --cwd apps/invitation dev -- --mode dev
scripts.dev:admin: set -a; . ./.env.dev; set +a; bun run --cwd apps/admin dev -- --mode dev
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:invitation && bun run build:admin
scripts.sync: bun run --cwd apps/web sync && bun run --cwd apps/invitation sync && bun run --cwd apps/admin sync
scripts.check: bun run check:web && bun run check:invitation && bun run check:admin
